Title: NRA floor rule vs mandatory action

Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hi,
i would like to know what happens when using
the NRA floor rule in this cases:
1.
A minion under Lunatic Eruption rush another minion, then is untapped:
is the minion forced to attack again another victim,
or the NRA takes precedence?
Should the card text take precedence over the NRA (as per the "golden rule
of card")?
Or the NRA applies anyway?

2.
A bloodless vamp got a pulled fangs on him. His/her controller minion phase
starts.
He's forced to hunt, goes into torpor,
but he's rescued and untapped by some means (same turn).
Should the vamp (bloodless) hunt again, as per the mandatory rule about
hunting,
or the NRA takes precedence over that rule
(and the vamp, unable to hunt, goes into torpor again by the PF effect?).

Thanks in advance
Emiliano, vekn prince of Rome

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tetragrammaton wrote:
>
> Hi,
> i would like to know what happens when using
> the NRA floor rule in this cases:
> 1.
> A minion under Lunatic Eruption rush another minion, then is untapped:
> is the minion forced to attack again another victim,
> or the NRA takes precedence?
> Should the card text take precedence over the NRA (as per the "golden rule
> of card")?
> Or the NRA applies anyway?

Both apply - neither has precendence.
The minion must "rush" and cannot - he is stuck and can take no action.

> 2.
> A bloodless vamp got a pulled fangs on him. His/her controller minion phase
> starts.
> He's forced to hunt, goes into torpor,
> but he's rescued and untapped by some means (same turn).
> Should the vamp (bloodless) hunt again, as per the mandatory rule about
> hunting,
> or the NRA takes precedence over that rule
> (and the vamp, unable to hunt, goes into torpor again by the PF effect?).

The NRA doesn't factor in here, since the vampire hasn't hunted.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tetragrammaton wrote:
> > Both apply.
> > NRA: Can't rush again.
> > Lunatic Eruption: Can't do anything but rush (unless he "must" hunt).
>
> Got it (thanks)
> Forgive me, please clarify what you're stating in your last line above:
> If a vampire both "must do action X" and "must hunt"
> the hunt takes anyway the precedence?

Only by explicit card text on Lunatic Eruption.
In general, if a minion had two mandatory actions (which isn't possible
under the current card set), he'd be stuck. Lunatic Eruption allows
the vampire to hunt if he must instead of rushing.

> Eg, a vamp got both a Lunatic Eruption and a XTC laced blood,
> what "must" he have to do when he starts (or during) his turn?

Since he must hunt (XTC), he is not forced to rush.
So he must hunt.
